filter: 3x3 mask-aware linear-power mean; radar-valid support only, never label-valid support
objective: Mean per-chip training F1, undefined F1 counted as0; ties choose first VV then most-negative threshold. Grid -30..-8dB step0.5. No NISAR -16dB reuse.
baseline: Per-image 256-bin Otsu on same selected band after same filtering, histogram uses radar validity only, never test annotations.
